description_en: Asynchronously translates text in a batch of images from one language to another and returns a new image for each input image
description_zh: 异步将一批图片上的文字从一种语言翻译成另一种语言，并分别输出新的图片
kebab_example: aliyun alimt translate-image-batch --image-urls https://example.com/1.jpg,https://example.com/2.jpg,https://example.com/3.jpg --source-language zh --target-language en --api-version 2018-10-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TranslateImageBatch

parameters.help_en: URLs of the source images. Separate multiple URLs with commas. A single request can include up to 20 URLs. Duplicate URLs are processed only once
parameters.help_zh: 原图 URL，多张图片使用半角逗号进行分割；单次请求 URL 总数不能超过 20，且相同的 URL 只会被处理一次
parameters.name: image_urls

parameters.help_en: Source language. For supported languages and their codes, see language codes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)
parameters.help_zh: 源语种，支持的语种及对应的代码请参考语言code (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: Target language. For supported languages and their codes, see language codes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)
parameters.help_zh: 目标语种，支持的语种及对应的代码请参考语言code (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en:
Extended information in JSON string format. Supported fields include the following.

needEditorData: Set to `true` or `false`. Default is `false`. Set to `true` to return editor data in the response. Use this only when you integrate your own image translation post-editing editor (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2507676.html).

ignoreEntityRecognize: Set to `true` or `false`. Default is `false`. For e-commerce image translation, the service automatically detects whether text appears on product entities in the image. If so, it skips translation. Set this field to `true` to disable that detection. This field has no effect on general image translation
parameters.help_zh:
扩展信息, JSON String 格式，里面可以包含的字段如下。
`needEditorData`：取值为字符串 `true`/`false`，默认为`false`，是否需要在结果中返回图片翻译译后编辑器数据，仅用于自行接入图片翻译译后编辑器 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2507676.html)时，获取数据使用
`ignoreEntityRecognize`：取值为字符串 `true`/`false`，默认为 `false`，电商领域图片翻译会自动判断文字是否在图片中的商品主体上，如果在，则略过翻译；使用本字段来控制是否进行上述判断，本字段对通用图片翻译无效
parameters.name: ext

parameters.help_en: Custom task ID. Prevent accidental duplicate requests within a short time. Requests with the same custom task ID are processed only once within three minutes
parameters.help_zh: 自定义任务 ID，用于防止短时间误操作重复请求；3 分钟内，相同自定义任务 ID 的请求只会被处理一次
parameters.name: custom_task_id

parameters.help_en:
Translation domain. Valid values:

`general`: General image translation

`e-commerce`: E-commerce image translation

If not specified or unrecognized, the service uses general image translation
parameters.help_zh:
翻译领域， 可选值如下。
`general`：通用图片翻译
`e-commerce`：电商领域图片翻译

默认及未识别领域均按通用图片翻译处理
parameters.name: field

TaskId.description_en: Task ID. Use this ID to retrieve translation results later
TaskId.description_zh: 任务 ID，用于后续获取翻译结果
